findings.action: Propagate memo lifecycle failures as transcript verification problems. After view.audit(), memoizedLedgerRead returns the zero string and errGovernanceReadViewFinalized without invoking the computation, but reviewRunTranscriptIntact discards the error and returns an empty string, which its callers interpret as an intact transcript. This affects both warmed and cold keys. Previously checkReviewRunTranscript reached Files.Lstat and returned a nonempty inspection failure. R4 error compatibility and the fail-closed integrity contract are therefore violated. Preserve the failure in the returned problem string and cover transcript checks after finalization.

Preserve SourceLoss when the memo refuses a header read. A finalized view makes memoizedLedgerRead return an error and a zero reviewHeaderObservation; this wrapper discards the error and returns owner empty, loss nil and readError empty. Previously observeReviewBundleHeader returned LossReadError and the underlying diagnostic. Consumers such as ReadReviewBundles skip an observation whose owner differs from the requested scope, so a lifecycle refusal can become an unreported omission instead of coverage loss. Convert memo errors into the existing read-error observation and cover finalized-view header reads.

Preserve dependency attribution for every producer consuming a memo cell. The operation-wide key excludes the Files producer, governanceReadViewFromFiles discards its wrapper, and a hit only calls begin/end before returning the first producer's result. Thus producer A can read a ledger, producer B can consume the same cached result, and a subsequent mutation or unreadable-input audit is attributed only to A. governance_read_view.go:2180 marks changed producers from the recorded file attribution, while obligation_projection.go:259-285 uses those names to downgrade individual producer coverage. B can consequently retain current coverage despite consuming the affected ledger. This violates R4 and the ADR's explicit producer-attribution contract. Retain and replay the derived value's input dependencies for each consumer, with a two-producer audit regression test.
